name: Projected Terminal Mobile Input Bar
description: Exposes attachment-safe software-keyboard control, essential terminal keys, and one-shot modifiers on coarse non-hover browser pointers.

states: Inspect all nine minimum-touch-target controls with the native keyboard focused and the one-shot Alt modifier armed.
Tap a key without moving DOM focus away from the projected terminal textarea.
Inspect localized Simplified Chinese labels with every input-producing control unavailable for a read-only attachment.

useWhen: A projected terminal is used from a browser with a coarse pointer and no hover capability.
avoidWhen: A fine-pointer desktop browser already provides a physical keyboard, or a non-terminal form owns text input.
invariants: Every input-producing control uses the exact active attachment revision and is disabled when that revision is unavailable.
Control and Alt are one-shot modifiers cleared by publication attempts, blur, composition, paste, downgrade, replacement, recovery, and disposal.
Key controls preserve textarea focus; the keyboard toggle reflects textarea focus and does not claim operating-system keyboard visibility.
The bar is absent from fine-pointer hover layouts and never stores mobile input state in Workbench documents or browser storage.
